P1.2.text: Doximity is the leading platform for U.S. healthcare professionals, trusted by over three million members, including more than 85% of U.S. physicians, to support everyday clinical work.

P1.4.text: Doximity is the largest verified network of healthcare professionals in the U.S., connecting clinicians across specialties and care settings.

P1.7.text: Integrated intelligence across your entire workflow

P1.8.text: AI-powered tools that work together to streamline documentation, communication, and clinical decision-making.

P1.9.text: Clinical answers you can actually trust.

P1.10.text: Physician-verified AI with full-text access to more than 2,000 peer-reviewed journals, from question to citation to original source in one click.

P1.12.text: Ambient AI that listens during your visit and generates structured notes the moment it ends, in-person or telehealth, with zero audio stored.

P1.13.text: Call patients without exposing your personal number.

P1.14.text: Voice, video, and secure text from your personal phone, with your office name on their caller ID and scribe capturing notes directly within the call.

P1.15.text: Send, receive, sign, and route faxes from your phone or tablet, no machine needed, with one-click EMR attachment and built-in e-sign so nothing ever hits a printer.

P1.16.text: One feed curated by your subspecialty, region, and system. Top-tier research, practice updates, and original Op-Med perspectives in a clinician-only space.

P1.17.text: Trusted by over 3 million U.S. clinicians

P1.18.text: Hear from the clinicians who rely on Doximity every day.

P1.19.text: I transferred a patient to another hospital several years ago and was able to quickly fax and send patient info via the Doximity app to my former medical school classmate who was working at the other hospital. It was 3am and the patient was admitted directly to the ICU. It was fantastically smooth and saved us so much time rather than having to traditionally fax medical records and information. Every little bit of time helps.

P1.20.text: I use this application on a daily basis. I use the Doximity dialer to call patients from my personal phone so that my personal number doesn't show up on their caller ID. Nothing but praise. Thanks, Doximity!

P1.21.text: I frequently consult my colleagues in different specialties using the Doximity app. I frequently utilize Doximity to access articles for teaching rounds as well as sharing articles with my colleagues. It allows me to multi-task and take care of patients while not being confined to a desk.

P1.22.text: The fact that Doximity Ask provides links to full-text medical journals, tables and society practice guidelines differentiates it from the crowd.

P1.23.text: Partnering with healthcare's most respected institutions.

P1.24.text: Leading health systems across the country rely on Doximity to connect with clinicians.

P2.2.text: Doximity is the largest community of healthcare professionals in the country.

P2.5.text: What makes Doximity the network clinicians trust

P2.6.text: Doximity gives clinicians the tools to work smarter, communicate faster, and focus on what matters most: their patients.

P2.8.text: Our professional medical network has a larger membership than the American Medical Association, and more doctors use Doximity than Epic, the top EMR in the United States. Doximity’s membership has expanded to include over 85% of physicians and an increasing number of NPs, PAs, and pharmacists. Aside from the iPhone, there’s never been a piece of technology adopted by clinicians as quickly as Doximity. If you’re a clinician, claim your profile today.

data.offering_description: Operates a digital platform that helps consumers find and save on prescription drug prices through discount cards and price comparison, plus paid memberships and telehealth visits. It earns from consumer subscriptions, pharmacy and manufacturer fees, and healthcare services.

data.primary_products: prescription discount cards; GoodRx Gold membership

data.customer_segment: B2C: US consumers buying prescription drugs without insurance or with high copays; B2B: pharmaceutical manufacturers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, retail pharmacies

data.end_markets: healthcare; pharmaceuticals; retail pharmacy; digital health

data.revenue_model: subscription: consumers paying for GoodRx Gold membership; advertising: pharmaceutical manufacturers paying for brand drug promotion on the platform; transaction or usage fees: fees from pharmacies and benefit managers for prescriptions filled through discount cards; service fees: consumers paying for telehealth visits and related care

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: consumer app and website connecting patients, pharmacies and drug makers; service provider: telehealth visits and prescription savings services sold to consumers and plans

data.geography_served: US national: all US states, with discount cards accepted at pharmacies nationwide

data.specialization: related lines: discount cards, membership subscriptions and telehealth, sharing consumers and pharmacy partners

data.distribution_channels: online: GoodRx mobile app and website where consumers find and use discounts; partners / resellers: retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers that accept discount cards; direct sales: sales of advertising and data services to pharmaceutical manufacturers

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: telehealth and health data subject to HIPAA, FTC consumer protection and state pharmacy and telehealth rules

data.offering_description: Operates a consumer digital platform that provides coupons and discounted prices on prescription drugs at pharmacies, plus subscription savings programs, telehealth and pharma manufacturer marketing solutions. Serves consumers, pharmacies' customers and pharmaceutical manufacturers through its website, mobile app and integrations.

data.primary_products: prescription discount coupons and savings cards; mobile and web app; subscription savings program

data.primary_services: prescription price comparison and discount access; pharma manufacturer advertising and access solutions; telehealth consultations; pharmacy benefit manager fee-based claims processing

data.customer_segment: B2C: consumers and patients, including uninsured and underinsured, filling prescriptions; B2B: pharmaceutical manufacturers buying marketing, pharmacy benefit managers, pharmacies

data.end_markets: retail pharmacy; prescription drugs; pharmaceutical marketing; telehealth

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: fees from pharmacy benefit managers for prescription fills using discount coupons; advertising: pharmaceutical manufacturer solutions such as ads and savings programs; subscription: monthly or annual savings program memberships; service fees: telehealth visits and other consumer health offerings

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: digital marketplace connecting consumers, pharmacies, PBMs and drug manufacturers; financial intermediary: takes price data from PBMs and pharmacies, sells savings to consumers

data.geography_served: US national: Consumers and pharmacies across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: prescription discounts, subscriptions, pharma manufacturer solutions and telehealth

data.distribution_channels: online: GoodRx website and mobile app; partners / resellers: integrations with pharmacies, healthcare providers and partner sites; direct sales: sales team selling to pharmaceutical manufacturers

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: health data privacy (HIPAA, FTC), telehealth rules, pharmacy and advertising regulation
